# Roles Index

Every role folder the pipeline knows about. The ideamaker reads this file first to (a) keep the fictional full-ideal candidate's name and school distinct from every prior role, (b) pick the one or two nearest-domain prior folders to read for cross-role memory, and (c) know which claimed projects already exist as repos. The critic uses the domain tags to pick exemplars. The pipeline appends a row after every completed job; keep the table machine-parseable (one row per role, columns as below).
